description: The pie chart titled "Token Routing Distribution (FedHLM)" illustrates the distribution of token routing in a federated learning model. The chart is divided into three slices, representing different routing methods. The largest slice, occupying 94.5% of the chart, is colored green and represents the LLM (Language Model) method. The second slice, colored red and representing the EDGE_P2P (Edge Peer-to-Peer) method, accounts for 3.9% of the chart. The smallest slice, colored blue and representing the LLM method, makes up 1.6% of the chart. The chart does not include a legend, and the percentages are labeled directly on the corresponding slices. The slices are not visually emphasized in any particular way.
